scope: These are processed, reduced JPEG cards, not native continuous model outputs. Their inability to expose a reading target does not establish absence of ink, nor does it identify a native ROI.
decision: No native CT investment justified by a selected glyph in these views. Check whether original continuous predictions or a documented pixel-to-native correspondence can provide a specific next target. Do not recover native XY from visual estimates of the JPEG.
